name: IceBarrel Go
description: The Frostonic IceBarrel Go is your grab-and-plunge cold therapy solution—compact, portable, and fully functional. Designed for travel, tight spaces, and quick setups, it’s ideal for users who want the full benefits of cold immersion wherever life takes them.
